info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_File Payment Consent Retrieval API
info.description: The File Payment Consent Retrieval API allows consumers to access specific file payment consents within the Open Banking ecosystem. By providing the necessary parameter, users can retrieve detailed information regarding file payment transactions, ensuring compliance with financial regulations. This API is particularly beneficial for financial institutions and payment service providers who require verified consent files for processing payments and auditing purposes. It streamlines the retrieval of essential documentation, enhancing transparency and operational efficiency in transaction management.

get.description: This operation allows you to retrieve a file payment consent by its unique identifier (RES-100045). It provides detailed information about the consent status and associated file.

requestBody.description: A JSON object representing the request to retrieve the file associated with the payment consent identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the request adheres to the specified schema for consistent data representation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested file payment consent data.

GetFilePaymentConsentByIdRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the payment consent operation.

GetFilePaymentConsentByIdResponse_200.title: File Payment Consents Response
GetFilePaymentConsentByIdResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response structure for a successful GET request for file payment consents.

Metadata.title: Response Metadata

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: A unique identifier to trace the request and response correlation.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region in which the processing of the request took place.

Metadata.description: This schema contains metadata related to the response, providing additional context such as identifiers and timestamps.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: Identifier for the endpoint that processed the file payment consent request.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the runtime application that handled the request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes bearer authentication using JSON Web Tokens (JWT). Clients must include a valid JWT in the 'Authorization' header of their requests to authenticate.
